mentions.name: Mog
mentions.description: Mog is a markup language with first-class document structure and embedded data, originally designed for a note-taking system. It provides capabilities that Markdown requires extensions to match, such as native document structure and inline embedded data.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Earlier this year, I started designing Mog, a markup language originally intended for my note-taking system.

As it's evolved, its strengths have come into focus. First-class document structure and embedded data give Mog capabilities that Markdown requires extensions to match.
